snippet.title: Stage Fright – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Stage Fright is coming in 2027 to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch!

From the makers of OVERCOOKED! comes Stage Fright, a new game where only those who can work together will succeed. Two players trapped in different dimensions must fight side-by-side, solve puzzles, and escape together to save their lost friend. A new co-op mechanic awaits you around every corner—from escape room puzzles to exciting, timed action and dimension-swapping madness. It’s a charming and challenging experience with online and couch co-op. Who will you play with?

#NintendoDirect #StageFright

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
